ae2_pattern_disk.configuration.additiona: Which names take part in the numeric level of the additional sort: each element is a Java regex (java.util.regex) searched for anywhere in the item’s display name; a match means the name takes part, the rest follow it in plain literal order. Backslashes must be doubled inside a TOML string, so prefer escape-free classes. The default [0-9] lets every name containing a digit take part; an empty list turns the level off, and a malformed element is skipped on its own.

Tier word table for the additional sort: one element per group, written as "mod filter:word1,word2,..." (the filter may be omitted, words run lowest to highest). Groups are tried in order and the first match wins, so go from specific to general. Words match fragments of the registry and display names; "chinese|english" matches either spelling. The config file comments list the defaults (Mekanism factories/alloys, Powah).
The two settings for the additional sort: the tier word table and the numeric-name gate. Only used when the additional sort is on and the order is by mod; the config file comments explain the syntax.
